**What these 20 ads have in common:**
- **Same headline templates:** "…just dropped", "Why thousands switched to this serum" and "…for everyday use" come up again and again across brands.
- **Same selling points in the body text:** star ratings with review counts (4.0–4.8 stars), risk-free trials of 14–90 days, free-shipping thresholds of $30–$90, and "limited stock, get it by Friday."
- **Every ad suggests another product:** each body ends with "Pair it with our cleanser / toner / eye cream / face mask."
- **Mostly new:** almost all of page 1 and half of page 2 started Oct 30.

Page 1 had 10 more ads, all started Oct 30, from brands including Kind Collective, Silver Nest, Pure Market, Peak Studio and Blue Market. The impression ranks only compare ads within the same brand, so I left them out. There's no data that compares brands with each other.
